description: This file contains implementation of big number arithmetic functions for cryptographic operations, including multiplication, squaring, addition, and subtraction of large integers, with optimized assembly and portable C code.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition of large number words with carry handling.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication of large number words with carry handling.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba8
methods.description: Optimized multiplication of two 8-word big numbers using Comba method.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba4
methods.description: Optimized multiplication of two 4-word big numbers using Comba method.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba8

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba4

methods.description: Adds two large numbers word-wise with carry handling.

methods.name: bn_sub_words
